answer: The handbook states that an employee dismissed after one year or more with one employer, or in one place of employment, is entitled to severance pay. It also states that the current minimum deposit is no less than 12.5% of the regular monthly salary for full-time work.
informationLabel: This summary is provided for general informational purposes only, and is not a substitute for the wording of the relevant laws, regulations, procedures and extension orders, which are binding.

claims.quote: An employee who is dismissed after working for one employer, or in one place of employment, for a period of one year or more, is entitled to severance pay (pitzuyei piturim).
The current minimum deposit to the deposit account by employers of foreign workers is no less than 12.5% of the worker's regular monthly salary for full time work.
